title: Down the Road of Kabul
description: In “Down the Road of Kabul,” by Mahtab E.B., an EmpowerHer student, the writer gives voice to the daily realities of Afghan women and girls living under Taliban rule. Through powerful poetry, she contrasts the world's dismissal of their suffering with the resilience and hope that continue to endure, affirming that while dreams may be delayed, they can never be silenced.
